initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is -0.4, but the checks establish arithmetic correctness only. Request archived design record R290-2 to assess whether the average causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The design record establishes random assignment independent of potential outcomes, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference. Thus the causal risk difference equals the observed contrast: 1/10 − 20/40 = −0.4.
